title: No-Heat and No-Cool Response Guarantee Credit — Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements
content:
Dispatch note on the response guarantee carried by Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements tiers.

**The guarantee.** A tier whose no-heat or no-cool response hours are above 0 guarantees technician arrival on a no-heat or no-cool service call for an enrolled system within that many elapsed hours of booking. Tiers whose hours are 0 carry no guarantee.

**When the credit is earned.** The credit is earned only when the technician arrived more than the tier's response hours after the call was booked. In addition, the call must:
- have the symptom no heat or no cool;
- have been booked while the agreement was active;
- not have been booked by the member for a later scheduled date than the earliest arrival window offered.

Elapsed hours are measured from the booking time to the arrival time recorded on the service call.

**The credit.** A missed guarantee earns a response guarantee credit at the tier's credit amount, posted to the dues balance and naming the service call. It offsets future dues and is paid out only if the agreement later closes with a credit balance. Only one response guarantee credit is posted per service call. Calls cancelled before arrival earn no credit.

### Boundary (hypothetical, 24-hour guarantee, call booked Monday 10:00)

| Technician arrived | Elapsed hours | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Tuesday 09:30 | 23.5 | None |
| Tuesday 10:00 | 24 | None — not more than 24 |
| Tuesday 10:15 | 24.25 | Earned |

### Points of judgement
| Situation | Credit |
|---|---|
| Member chose a later day than the earliest window offered | None |
| Call booked while the agreement was past due | None |
| Call for a noisy fan, arrival late | None — symptom is not no heat or no cool |
| A credit already posted naming the same call | No second credit |
